flags.message: distribution_count=2 here is two pre-conference reschedules (DISTRIBUTED 9/09 for 9/28, Rescheduled 9/22; DISTRIBUTED 10/05 for 10/9, Rescheduled 10/05), not relists: the petition has not yet been considered at any conference. The relist-count cut's bucket-2 rate therefore does not describe this petition's position, and I anchored on the elevated band's reached rate instead, adjusted down. A reschedule-aware count beside distribution_count would let cells and the band scorer separate the two.
